BiblicalUsage: Sheshan is the man of Judah who has no sons, only daughters. He gives his daughter to Jarha his Egyptian servant, so that the line goes on through Attai.
TheologicalSignificance: No sons does not mean no future in God's book, because the line finds a way. I believe Sheshan's daughter is the proof that God keeps a family alive by means He chooses.
